name: Duolingo Super

fastest.text: In the Duolingo app, tap the Super icon → Settings (gear) → Manage subscription → Cancel subscription, then confirm in the App Store or Google Play.

steps: Open the Duolingo app and tap the Super icon at the top of the home screen.
Tap Settings (the gear icon), then Manage subscription.
Select Cancel subscription and go through the steps.
Confirm the cancellation in the App Store or Google Play when it opens.
note: Subscribed on the website? Sign in on duolingo.com, click your profile picture → Settings → Super Duolingo → Cancel subscription.

faq.a: No. Your streak and learning progress aren't affected, and you keep Super features until the end of the period you've paid for.

Usually not: Duolingo says in-app purchases are nonrefundable and partly used periods aren't refunded. Apple handles refunds for iPhone subscriptions; for web or Android, Duolingo support can review a request.

faq.q: Does deleting the app cancel Super?
faq.a: No. Deleting the app or your Duolingo account doesn't cancel the subscription.
